title: Hospital unit exception decisions
observations: Frontline supervisors must seek manager permission for common exceptions.
Managers reverse some delegated decisions without stated criteria.
Employees escalate low-risk issues to avoid blame.
Leadership messages encourage empowerment while approval rules remain unchanged.
participant_claims: Leaders say employees should take more ownership.
researcher_interpretations: Formal and de facto authority may conflict.
assumptions: Reluctance to decide reflects employee motivation.
